prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a square waist-up character profile illustration of ONE original adult male elf of Mirkwood for The One Ring. The latest attached book illustration is a STYLE and costume reference: match its warm muted reddish-brown pencil and fine pen contours, medium-density directional hatching, selective layered crosshatching, and pale cream paper highlights. Do not reproduce the group composition or any individual exactly.
Subject: slender, capable woodland elf with a long angular face, high cheekbones, pointed ears, clean-shaven jaw, shoulder-length flowing hair partly tied back, calm alert eyes and a reserved expression. He is an experienced forest scout. Practical layered elven tunic with subtle leaf-pattern trim, leather wrist guard, short woodland mantle with hood down, simple leaf clasp, cross-body quiver strap. A quiver with a few arrow fletchings appears behind one shoulder. One naturally drawn hand lightly holds an elegant wooden bow at his side, with part of its curve visible along the edge of the composition. No crown or royal staff. Three-quarter view with head clearly readable and room around it for avatar cropping. Include shoulders, torso and hand in the square.
Drawing: expressive slightly stylized traditional fantasy book illustration, fine irregular warm umber contours, small short hatch marks defining cheek planes, shadows under brow and jaw, strands of hair and folds in cloth. Small dark brown pockets under overlapping mantle and inside hair, generous unmarked light paper across lit face and cloth. Moderate descriptive detail, midway between outline drawing and fully rendered portrait; no smooth blended shading. Pale nearly white ivory paper background with faint sketch hatching immediately behind shoulders fading to blank paper. No landscape, text, border, watermark, photographic actor likeness, skin pores, gray graphite wash, filled color or thick cartoon outlines. One character only. Square 1:1 for final 640x640 WebP profile image.
